name: Distinguished Service Award (miniature medal body)
size_basis: estimated: the body measured in the Vanguard product photograph against the suspension ribbon's width, 182 px taken as 0.6875 in (the miniature suspension ribbon, 11/16 in, CAPR 39-1 11.3 as compose.js MINI_DRAPE): body 0.6497 x 0.6951 in in the photograph. Height follows the body's own aspect. The width is the existing CAP asset's (0.625 in, assets/medals, kept as the brief asks; the photo measures 0.6497 in). The drawing keeps the width and the box; it is built from the photograph's own measured proportions (body width 172.3 px = 0.625 in).
ribbon_attach_note: ribbon_attach is the top centre of the suspension ring (or of the bail where the box cuts the ring away), on the body axis: the body is upright, the photograph's hang angle (0 deg) is removed; compose.js hangs it at the drape's V point

not_measurable: band lettering: the text strip across the middle is noise at 2800 px/in in the polished-gold photograph (letters cannot be told apart); the band is drawn as a plain framed plate with its end caps, bottom rail and top bead row, no letters invented; its interior is excluded from the gates (P.sel)

banner lettering (both banners): the ribbons carry lettering that is not legible in this photograph, so the ribbons are drawn plain (outline, upper edge bar, rounded inner end, hook and scroll curl at the outer end); the die is the same as the Exceptional and Meritorious Service Awards, so the words are very probably SEMPER (left) and VIGILANS (right): not drawn, a decision for the owner; the ribbon interiors are excluded from the gates (P.sel)

laurel leaves: individual leaf outlines, veins and serration are below the photograph resolution (leaves are about 0.06 in long, veins 0.005 in); each branch is a measured stem with seven leaf pairs placed by orientation and extent of the lit mass, the right branch mirrored to the left

wing feathers: the row pitch (0.0097 in) is 2.7 photograph pixels; both wings carry the same ten rows, placed by measured start, end and curvature (read on the better lit left wing; the right wing of the photograph shows fewer rows because of the light), not each barb
eagle head: about 0.045 in wide, 12 px in the photograph; drawn as a lump with one recessed spot, beak direction not resolved

tail: the three feather ovals of each fan are placed from the lit stripes (outer ovals reach the band, the middle one starts under the arched opening); barbs, the talons and the pennant are 10 to 15 px shapes drawn as a paddle and a fan with two recessed triangles
banner curls: drawn as a spiral of measured size and centre with the link to the ribbon end; the number of turns and the knobs under the curl are not resolved

left and right halves of the photograph are not exactly mirror images (wing outlines are centred at -0.004, banner ends at +0.0055, tail at +0.0025, laurel +0.003): each pair is mirrored about its own measured axis
specular glints on the bail, ring and band (polished gold) are lighting, not features; the ring is hidden above v=-0.49 by the ribbon in the photograph
fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 26, batch B): every element is modelled as the object it is (letters, stars, wreath leaves, banner, aircraft ...) with its proportions measured from the photograph and placed by measurement; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge; upright. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph mask in the same box (lib-b.js)

notes: Designed miniature medal body (LIVE13-ART 26, batch B), upright. Measured from distinguished-service.jpeg (reference only, never shipped). Hang angle 0 deg of the photograph removed. The photograph hangs at 1.5 deg by the bail, but the hexagon flats, the band and the symmetry of the outline all level at about 0 deg (flats vertical to 0.5 deg, upper and lower corner heights equal to 0.006 in), so the body is levelled at 0 deg: P.frame.th = 0. The band tilts a further -1.4 deg in the photograph (right end higher); that tilt is kept as measured. The body is 0.619 in wide and 0.683 in high between vertices in the photograph; the spec box (0.625 x 0.6691 in, unchanged) is 0.0345 in shorter than the vertex to vertex height, so the model is drawn in the hex frame and shifted 0.0345 in up in the shipped frame: the bottom vertex sits on the bottom of the box (the top vertex is cut by 0.014 in by the box top, the bail is above it). The ribbon ring top is cut by the box. The die is the same as the Exceptional and Meritorious Service Awards (eagle with head, wings of nested feather curves, two banners, tail of two fans, pennant, two laurel branches, framed band): the banners are almost certainly SEMPER and VIGILANS but are unlettered here (illegible in the photograph); the band is unlettered.
